plan.scope: All existing synthetic Pilot measurements including the former test set; descriptive offline oracle only. No codecs, model prediction/training, memory measurement or real-file evaluation.
plan.cost_unit: arbitrary policy cost points, not currency or measured CPU/energy cost
plan.anchor_interpretation: At multiplier 1, one millisecond of compression/decompression latency has the same hypothetical policy cost as retaining one MiB for one day. This is a declared sensitivity anchor, not an empirically fitted or real pricing ratio.

profiles.reason: Hypothetical annual archive restored once in its retained lifetime
Hypothetical month retained with one full restoration per day
Hypothetical one-day object with frequent full restoration

plan.cost_scenario_rule: Full Cartesian product of profiles and time multipliers; scale both latency coefficients by the multiplier, keep storage coefficient unchanged. All scenarios are reported; multiplier 1 is a reference illustration, not an adopted profile.
plan.deadline_scenario_rule: Full Cartesian product of absolute per-file codec deadlines spanning sub-ms to 100ms policy budgets. Chosen as a coarse hypothetical grid, not from Pilot quantiles. Include all input sizes and report size groups; no proportional-size rescaling.

comparison_policy.reference: fixed zstd; not a newly fitted majority baseline
comparison_policy.cost_saving_pct: 100 * (sum fixed-zstd policy cost - sum oracle policy cost) / sum fixed-zstd policy cost; per-file percentages reported separately
comparison_policy.strict_gain: chosen cost strictly less than zstd cost; exact ties are distinct
comparison_policy.deadline_denominators: Report all-sample selection share and feasible-subset share separately. Unsatisfied samples stay in the denominator of all-sample counts.
comparison_policy.deadline_regret: Size saving versus zstd only when zstd itself meets the same limits; when zstd violates and another is feasible, report feasibility recovery separately
comparison_policy.ten_percent_other_codec_share: descriptive reference only; not a selection/acceptance criterion

verification_numeric_tolerance.purpose: Independent exact-Fraction cost comparison only; never used for choosing winners or merging ties

plan.preservation: Keep original measurements, official v2 labels, configuration, models and all prior evidence byte-identical. New derived tables are exploratory candidate results, not official new labels.
plan.failure_policy: Existing output refused. Incomplete/invalid source or input/source hash drift aborts and is preserved. No sample removal, fallback codec, scenario replacement or post-result parameter changes.
interpretation_limits: Oracle has access to all codec results; it is not an achieved Smart/model improvement
Cost savings depend on hypothetical policies; magnitudes across scenarios are not directly comparable
Stored median codec times exclude features, prediction, verification and I/O; no tail-latency or end-to-end guarantee
The explored Pilot is development data; preserve a separate held-out evaluation for later frozen definitions
